name: siau-wei-ai-chatbot-extension
description: VS Code Copilot-powered chatbot for CCV platform utilization data.

commands.title: Siau Wei AI Chatbot: Open Chat
Siau Wei AI Chatbot: Sync Data Source

siauWeiChat.dataSource.description: Choose whether the chatbot reads data from a local folder or syncs from SharePoint.

siauWeiChat.dataFolder.description: Folder containing CCV CSV/Excel files. Used when siauWeiChat.dataSource is "local".

siauWeiChat.sharePoint.folderPath.description: Folder path inside the SharePoint document library.

siauWeiChat.sharePoint.tenantId.description: Optional Microsoft Entra tenant ID used for sign-in. Not a secret. Leave empty to use the default tenant.

siauWeiChat.sharePoint.clientId.description: Optional Microsoft Entra application (client) ID used for sign-in. Not a secret. Leave empty to use the built-in VS Code Microsoft application.
